note: Only public-looking county parcel layer (GDITAdmin 'Parcels - MI - Saginaw County', services3 CmHnqlf5e6ltOCrY/County_Parcels_2_15_22/FeatureServer/0) refuses every request: metadata returns 'Invalid URL' and query returns 400 with geojson on and off.
